nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Near the terrace stair: Taly, pale under party lighting. A ministry fixer has her cornered over a mis-attributed remark — the kind that ends careers if it hardens into minutes.

choices.text: Intervene. Burn time, maybe heat, maybe the clean exit with the fragment.
Keep moving. Fragment first. People survive gossip.
Signal Maris — she can extract Taly while you still move.

faculty_interjections.text: This is the test Wren hoped you'd fail professionally and pass as a person.
Intervention is visible. Visibility is heat. Heat eats exits.
Taly clocked you all night. She still deserves a corridor.
If Maris sees you walk away, you become another operator. Accurate. Fatal.
Split option: share risk, share credit, share failure modes.

nodes.speaker: cassian_vale
nodes.text: The remark was mine — misheard, misfiled. I was explaining freight variance and used an ugly metaphor. Log it against Orth, not Renn.

faculty_interjections.text: Deliver blame like a memo. Bored, precise, done.

nodes.speaker: taly_renn
nodes.text: You just volunteered for paperwork hell. Either you're decent or playing a long game so elaborate I almost respect it. Maris — your liaison has dimensions.

effects.summary: You took blame to shield Taly from a fixer.

choices.text: Dimensions are accidental. I should go be late for something important.

faculty_interjections.text: Sera just got a free minute. Assume she used it.
Worth it. Argue with Wren later.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: You pass like a professional weather system. Behind you, the fixer's voice sharpens. Ahead, the fragment path stays clear — clearer than your stomach.

effects.summary: You prioritized the mission over helping Taly.

faculty_interjections.text: Maris saw. Or will hear. Same damage.

nodes.speaker: maris_quell
nodes.text: I see it. Go. I'll take Taly — and later you'll explain why you trusted me with the human part of your evening.

effects.summary: You signaled Maris to extract Taly while you continued the mission.

choices.text: Because the human part was never optional.

faculty_interjections.text: Mission path mostly intact. Social ledger improved.
